title: Awesome Seedream 5.5 Prompts
titleZh: Seedream 5.5 提示词与作品精选
description: A curated collection of ByteDance Seedream 5.5 images shared on X: portraits, film stills, sci-fi and product design, precise multi-turn edits, and same-prompt comparisons against GPT Image, Nano Banana, Midjourney and more. Every entry credits its creator and links the original post, with verbatim public prompts you can open on ChatImg in one click.

entries.title: A barn owl before a gothic castle under the full moon, stop-motion style
entries.titleZh: 满月下哥特城堡前的仓鸮，定格动画风插画
entries.prompt: A detailed, high-fantasy digital stop-motion style illustration featuring a majestic barn owl with bright amber eyes perched on a mossy, gnarled tree branch in the foreground. The owl is the central focus, surrounded by a dark, atmospheric forest setting during autumn. The forest floor is dotted with glowing, bioluminescent mushrooms and scattered orange maple leaves. In the background, a mysterious, gothic-style castle looms under a large, luminous full moon in a misty, dark blue sky. To the left, a weathered tombstone with a skull carving stands near a wrought-iron fence and a glowing lantern, enhancing the eerie, magical, and autumnal mood of the scene. The lighting is moody and cinematic, with soft glows emanating from the mushrooms and the distant castle windows.
entries.note: Generated with Seedream 5.5 on Magnific (per the author).

entries.title: A boho-jacket street portrait: Kling Image 4.0 vs Seedream 5.5 vs MiniMax H3 Image vs GPT Image 2.6
entries.titleZh: 波西米亚外套街拍人像：Kling Image 4.0、Seedream 5.5、MiniMax H3 Image、GPT Image 2.6 对比
entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic fashion portrait of a naturally beautiful young adult woman wearing an extravagant colorful vintage-inspired outfit.

Character Appearance:
A young East Asian woman with delicate natural facial features, warm fair skin, soft brown almond-shaped eyes, naturally defined eyebrows, subtle freckles, a small beauty mark near the lower cheek, and naturally glossy muted pink lips. Her hair is dark brown, short-to-medium length, messy layered shag haircut with soft wispy bangs, natural volume and numerous loose flyaway strands.

Hair Details:
Beautifully messy, voluminous dark brown hair with individual strands illuminated by sunlight. Natural movement, imperfect texture and loose strands framing both sides of her face.

Outfit:
An oversized, richly patterned vintage bohemian jacket featuring vibrant orange, red, turquoise, emerald green, pink and cream colors. Intricate decorative motifs, embroidered-looking patterns, traditional textile-inspired prints and layered fabrics. Underneath, a colorful patterned top with a beige crossbody bag strap running diagonally across her chest.

Accessories:
Large statement ethnic-inspired dangling earrings featuring colorful beads, miniature decorative ornaments, tassels and intricate details.

Pose and Expression:
Medium close-up portrait from the waist upward. Her body is slightly turned while her face looks directly toward the camera. A calm, naturally expressive gaze with slightly parted lips. Relaxed shoulders and effortless candid posture.

Environment:
An outdoor urban setting with a softly blurred architectural background, natural greenery and subtle circular bokeh highlights. Background should remain unobtrusive and beautifully out of focus.

Lighting:
Bright natural daylight with beautiful backlighting illuminating her messy hair. Soft sunlight highlights across her face, realistic facial shadows, delicate light reflections and natural skin tones.

Photography Style:
Premium editorial fashion photography, authentic 85mm DSLR portrait, shallow depth of field, cinematic natural light, realistic optical bokeh, subtle film grain, lifelike colors, documentary-style candid composition.

Image Quality:
Ultra-photorealistic RAW DSLR photography, 8K ultra-high resolution, incredibly detailed skin pores, natural facial imperfections, individual eyelashes, realistic hair strands, intricate fabric patterns, detailed embroidery and authentic textile textures.

Negative Instructions:
No plastic skin, no excessive beauty filters, no artificial smoothness, no CGI, no illustration, no anime, no distorted hands, no unnatural facial proportions, no text, no typography, no watermark.

Vertical 3:4 portrait composition.

entries.prompt:
A: "Change only the colour of her cream knitted sweater to deep burgundy red. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same woman, same face, same hair, same pose, same room and same lighting."
B: "Replace only the ceramic mug on the books on the left with a small clear glass vase holding a single red rose. Keep everything else exactly the same: the same woman, same face, same hair, same pose, same sweater, same room and same lighting."
entries.note: Outside-edit drift, lower is better. Recolour (large area): Ideogram 4.6 1.75, Seedream 5.5 1.28. Swap a small object: Ideogram 4.6 1.29, Seedream 5.5 1.66.

entries.title: A couple embracing on a tropical beach at golden hour
entries.titleZh: 金色黄昏的热带海滩上相拥的情侣
entries.prompt:
A cinematic romantic still photograph captured on a 35mm motion picture camera — a slightly low-angle medium three-quarter shot of an extraordinarily attractive, movie-star-caliber young East Asian couple embracing on a tropical beach at golden-hour sunset, capturing the joyful moment as the man effortlessly lifts the woman high into the air against a pastel pink and gold twilight sky.

The strikingly handsome, tall, broad-shouldered man in his mid-20s possesses sculpted aristocratic bone structure, a sharp chiseled jawline, a high straight nose bridge, deep expressive eyes, and effortlessly styled tousled jet-black hair. Wearing an unbuttoned relaxed black linen shirt with rolled sleeves, his strong arms wrap securely around her thighs to lift her upward as he gazes up at her with a warm, captivating smile. The breathtakingly gorgeous, slender woman features an exquisite delicate side profile, graceful swan neck, luminous rosy-flushed porcelain skin, and a sculpted bare back. Wearing a lightweight white backless spaghetti-strap sundress tied with a large silk ribbon bow at her lower back, she rests her hands on his shoulders and looks down into his eyes with an enchanting, shy smile. Captured mid-motion, her lustrous dark chestnut hair and trailing white dress ribbons sweep dramatically through the sea breeze.

The setting is a serene tropical coastline with soft-focus palm tree silhouettes along the shore beneath a dreamy sky blending from twilight blue into warm pink and glowing sunset gold. Strong golden backlighting wraps her flying hair, bare back, and sheer flowing fabric in radiant warm rim light, while floating sun-kissed bokeh particles shimmer in the hazy sea air.

Captured with a wide-latitude cinema package and a 50mm vintage anamorphic lens at f/2.0, producing creamy oval bokeh, soft organic halation, and gentle lens flare. Flattering, fine, even real human skin with warm subsurface scattering, strand-by-strand windblown hair physics, natural linen and chiffon textures, and fine 35mm theatrical film grain — photographed on real film, never CGI, never plastic, never 3D render.

entries.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic 8K editorial fashion photograph of a young European woman standing casually beside an old, weathered vintage pickup truck on a deserted countryside dirt road.

Character appearance: A young European woman with pale natural skin, delicate facial features, subtle freckles, deep brown eyes, and a short messy black bob haircut with soft, uneven bangs. Her expression is calm, slightly serious, effortless and natural.

Outfit: An oversized faded blue denim jacket with worn fabric and realistic stitching, a black vintage graphic band T-shirt underneath, layered black necklaces, a black belt, and loose dark charcoal jeans. Both hands casually tucked into the jacket pockets.

Pose and composition: She is leaning her back and hip against the side of an old rusty light-blue pickup truck, standing with one leg slightly bent. Her body is angled naturally while her face looks directly toward the camera. Capture her from approximately mid-thigh upward, with the truck occupying the left side of the frame.

Environment: A quiet rural countryside setting with an old dirt road extending into the distance, dry grass, scattered trees, and an overcast pale grey sky. The pickup truck has faded blue paint, visible rust patches, dusty windows, and authentic vintage wear.

Photography style: Authentic 35mm analog film photography, early 2000s European indie-film aesthetic, muted earthy colors, soft natural overcast daylight, subtle film grain, realistic skin texture, natural imperfections, soft shadows, documentary-style composition, slightly imperfect candid framing.

Image quality: Extremely photorealistic, 8K ultra-high resolution, finely detailed facial features, individual hair strands, realistic denim texture, authentic rust and weathering, professional photography, sharp subject focus, natural depth of field.

Important: Preserve realistic human anatomy and natural proportions. No beauty filters, no artificial skin smoothing, no exaggerated makeup, no illustration, no CGI, no text overlays, no watermark. Vertical 3:4 portrait composition.
